mechanism_notes: Canonical CARLA jerk uses gated/clamped ego_a, whole-series producer filter and T_AEB-to-run-end window; not raw IMU/GT jerk
Diagnostic GT jerk is stored in report.braking with its own recorder clock, raw signal, window and duration weighting
limitations: Calibration validity domain and physical response attribution remain unknown

hint.mechanism: Demand ramp gradient links command buildup to response; recorded jerk retains its producer signal/filter/window
tradeoffs: rms_jerk_mps3: faster or stronger response can increase jerk; filtering and the T_AEB window affect the recorded objective
impact_speed_mps: earlier or stronger braking may reduce contact speed only within an actionable, attainable opportunity
stopping_distance_m: earlier onset changes the trace window; slower buildup can lengthen stopping travel and the extrapolated tail
Earlier intervention may increase acceptable caution or false braking; no monotonic improvement is asserted
counterevidence: Association and mechanism review are not causal isolation
